name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Summary**
A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

**Use case / User story**
Describe the user need this feature solves. Example:

- As a user, I want to ... so that ...

**Proposed solution (optional)**
If you have a proposal for how to implement this, include short details.

**Alternatives considered**
If applicable, mention alternatives and why they are not ideal.

**Additional context**
Any extra information, mockups, or links.
